brain: canonical Shiu LIF model on FlyWire v783 (unmodified); chunked interactive runtime (d7_runtime) + LearningBrain (d11_learning)

design.paradigm: forced-pairing blocks + free-choice tests (Aso-2014 style); pilots showed the bilateral regime is a decision boundary (balanced -> STOP timeouts; any imbalance -> one-sided basin), so instrumental left/right learning from exploratory commits is not viable in the frozen brain - pairing decouples learning from exploration
design.pairing_trial: single target (presented side), innate approach; US = 1.0 s PAM @150 Hz at commit toward the presented side
design.test_trial: two identical targets, NO US, choice = first +/-40 deg heading commit (2.5 s cap)

interface.visual: Gate-3 channels at the bilaterally calibrated rates (target_left=134.0 Hz, target_right=150.0 Hz from bilateral_calibration.json - exactly the configuration the validating pilot3 ran under; the loader in run_session reads the calibration file, and the A control measures the resulting innate test-choice baseline)
interface.cs: per-side KC ensembles (200/side, seed 20260928), fixation-gated foveal tuning R*clamp(1-|b|/90); kc_cs_left PRE-COMMIT rate 102.3 Hz from the bilateral valence calibration (kc_cs_right 75 Hz reference) - the LC9->KC path is dynamically silent (probes P2/P3), and LC9 drive does not touch MBONs, so this calibration transfers to the strong visual regime
interface.us: direct PAM stimulation (ENGINEERED optogenetic-style entry; probe P1: sugar->PAM dynamically silent; D4-D6 3.3 tier-3a)

plasticity.rule: reward(PAM gate >=10 Hz) depresses KC->avoidance-MBON; punishment(PPL1 gate >=10 Hz) depresses KC->approach-MBON (Aso 2014 / Owald 2015 sign rule)
plasticity.elig_power_note: induction nonlinearity (e/max)^power, power=2 from pilot cross-contamination evidence
plasticity.update_timing: relax(1 trial) then update, at trial end

decoder.addition: valence bias beta*[(appr_L-avoid_L)-(appr_R-avoid_R)] added to the P9 turn differential (D4-D6 3.3 tier-3c; probe P4 evidence: MBON->DN wiring does not reach walk command populations)
decoder.beta_note: readout gain frozen from pilot calibration

B.note: pair RIGHT (against the innate LEFT test preference) = the strong acquisition test; extinction; reversal to LEFT

A.note: frozen Gate-3 weights, US still delivered

C.note: dopamine gates lagged one trial (broken pairing)

D.note: plasticity through a seeded permuted eligibility->KC mapping

E_rl.note: non-biological Q-learner on the same schedule

metrics: P(paired side | decided test trials) per phase + halves

gate4_criteria.G4_1: B acquisition: P(paired side | decided) second half > first half AND exceeds the matched A control (bootstrap 95% CI on the difference excludes 0)
gate4_criteria.G4_2: A (no plasticity) shows NO acquisition trend
gate4_criteria.G4_3: C (shuffled DA) fails to acquire or is severely degraded
gate4_criteria.G4_4: D (shuffled KC/MBON) fails to acquire or is severely degraded
gate4_criteria.G4_5: extinction: test preference declines toward baseline when the US is withheld
gate4_criteria.G4_6: reversal: test preference flips to the other side within the reversal phase
gate4_criteria.honesty: if any criterion fails, report FAIL; no post-hoc parameter changes after the matrix starts
